blocks.text: Glendale is a suburb of the City of Lake Macquarie, New South Wales, Australia, located 15 kilometres (9 mi) west of Newcastle's central business district at the northern tip of Lake Macquarie city.
Glendale City Centre is a large shopping centre located in the suburb of Glendale in the City of Lake Macquarie, Australia.
